entities.summary: Čajetina is a small town and municipality located in the Zlatibor District of western Serbia. According to the 2022 census results, the municipality has 14,585 inhabitants. One of the most notable settlements in the municipality of Čajetina is a popular tourist town of Zlatibor. Čajetina is a town in Southern Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
